source: S&P 500 constituents from Wikipedia; company financial statements, market cap and prices from Yahoo Finance via yfinance
universe_method: Current S&P 500 constituents backcast to their available annual financial history
history_window: latest up to 5 available fiscal years
notes: Sector ratios are aggregated from numerator/denominator totals, not simple averages of company ratios.
Historical market cap uses fiscal-date close multiplied by reported shares outstanding when available; current shares are a fallback.
Financials excludes corporate-style net debt/EBITDA, FCF, ROIC and EBITDA margin as non-comparable; ROE is retained.
